operation.body:
### Goal

Implement **FR-003**: users can assign or change a feedback item's category.

### Acceptance criteria

- Allow changing category to only `bug`, `feature request`, or `other` (match existing model validation).
- Uncategorized new submissions continue to default to `other` (FR-001 behaviour unchanged).
- Category changes persist after reload (same SQLite database).
- On a failed category update, show a readable error, leave stored data unchanged, and keep the submission form usable per acceptance details in `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md`.
- Provide labelled, keyboard-accessible category controls with unique IDs per item where multiple controls appear on one page.
- Add automated tests for valid category change, invalid category rejection, and persistence after reload at an appropriate boundary.
- Run `bin/rails test`, `bash tests/test-adapter.sh`, and `./scripts/check-workflow-leak.sh`; report results in the PR validation section.
- Do not implement filtering (FR-004), process-restart acceptance evidence (FR-005), broader invalid-request handling beyond category (FR-006), sample dataset or final docs pass (FR-008), or edits to `docs/security-review.md`.

### Constraints

Parent project authorization is `self-correcting-review auto-merge`. Inherit eligible auto-merge when preconditions are met. Branch name must include `issue-<n>`. Keep the change reviewable in one PR.

### Out of scope

Category filters, restart/process-boundary evidence, authentication, production deployment, CI workflow redesign, and unrelated documentation churn.

### Relevant context

FR-001 and FR-002 are on `main` (goals #12 and #14; PRs #13 and #15): `Feedback` model with `category` inclusion validation, index/show/new/create flows. See `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` FR-003 and acceptance details for invalid category recovery.
